english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the buttocks.
Use 屁股 as the ordinary colloquial word for a buttock or the buttocks.
Use this colloquial noun for the buttocks or, depending on context, the anus.

examples.english: I've been sitting all day, and my bum hurts.
examples.traditional: 我坐咗成日，屁股都痛喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 co5 zo2 seng4 jat6 pei3 gu2 dou1 tung3 laa3

examples.english: I hurt my bun when I fell.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dit3 can1 go3 pei3 gu2

examples.english: My bottom hurts after sitting for too long.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 co5 noi6 zo2 pei3 gu2 dou1 tung3 laa3
